result: Training on randomly-nudged puzzles changed nothing measurable at either seed (unseen 172/170 vs controls 172/170; frontier +7 at both seeds but below the significance bar; standard-exam wasted moves slightly WORSE). conclusion: Not adopted: uniform slide-nudged training data did not help. The idea survives in sharper form for wave 5: train on the slides the hybrid search actually SELECTS, not random ones.
